greeting: Ataniup Atiani, Ataatap, Iluqqutillu, Taima Taaquq. Quviasuktumik atautikkut tautuqatigiitugut.
penitential:
Atani, nalliginnga.
Kristu, nalliginnga.
Atani, nalliginnga.
homily:
Ullaakkut, qiviartariaqarpugut inuusiup iluani, qanuq inuusiq asanniniqarpalaurmat. Akingitugut, pisuinnarata, nalliginnguarniq silami takujariaqarpugut. Qanuq takujariaqarpugut silami? Ullaakkut, uqalimaaqtitilluta Philippians nunaanni, Paul uqaqtuq: 'Have among yourselves the same attitude that is also yours in Christ Jesus.' Qanuq taanna inuusiq ataniq Jesus qaniginialiqtuq? Who, though he was in the form of God, did not regard equality with God something to be grasped. Rather, he emptied himself, taking the form of a slave, coming in human likeness.

Taanna inuusiq, qanuq tusaajariaqarpugut? Benjamin, taanna qaujimajavut tallimat pivalliajut, nuannaartuq, qajangnartuq, pinniqtuq. Taanna qaujimajavut asannininga, qanuq inuusiq tusaajariaqarpugut. Benjamin, taanna qaujimajavut asannininga. Taanna 'con chim airlines'-mik uqalaurmat, quviasulluni. Taanna qajuqtuq inuusiup iluani, ataniup asannininga ilisimallugu. Ilisimaliqput taanna asanniniq, kikkut nalligijavut aniguqtilaaqtut.

Alan, Thao, ilissik uqumaittumik atuqtut, qanigijaqput nalligivikluq ataniq qaninganiittuq. Ilisimajariaqarpugut ataniq qaninganiittuq. Ilissik ilisimajariaqarpugut asanniniq aniguqtilaaqtuq. Ryan, my dear brother, your brother Ben loved you. He was your partner. When you look at the sky, when you see a plane soaring high, remember that Ben's spirit is soaring too. He is free, he is full of light, and he is watching over you with a bright, gentle smile.

Jesus uqaqtuq gospel-mi: 'A man gave a great dinner to which he invited many.' Kikkut tusaajariaqarpugut? Kikkut nalligijavut aniguqtilaaqtut. Ataniq uqaqtuq, kikkut tusaajariaqarpugut silami. Ilisimajariaqarpugut ataniq qaninganiittuq. Benjamin, taanna qaujimajavut tallimat pivalliajut, nuannaartuq, qajangnartuq, pinniqtuq. Taanna nalligivikluq, nalligikpatiklu qitiqquqsimajuq.

What can you carry out the door today? Take the peace of Christ. Take the memory of Benjamin's radiant smile. Know that you are deeply loved, held, and never alone. Benjamin Vo, taanna asanniniq, taanna qaujimajavut tallimat pivalliajut. Taanna qaujimajavut inuusiup iluani, qanuq inuusiq asanniniqarpalaurmat.
communion: Jesusi Qajangnartuq, ilisimajunga qaninganiitutit inuusiup iluani. Asavigit pimmariqataullutit. Inuusinni kikkutuinnarnut tunijaugavit, turaaqtitsivigit inuusiup iluani. Taima qajangnartumik ilisimaliqput, uqaqtuq ataniq asannininga kikkutuinnarnut tunijaupalaurmat. Amen.
closing: Ataniup asannininga ilissik qaninganiittuq, uqumaittumik atuqtitillusi. Amen.
standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo kikkullu qaujimajavut aniguqtilaaqtut, ataniup light-ani pisuttut.
Kikkut uqumaittumik atuqtut, ataniup asannininga qaninganiittuq.

readings.label: Reading 1
readings.text: Brothers and sisters: Have among yourselves the same attitude that is also yours in Christ Jesus, Who, though he was in the form of God, did not regard equality with God something to be grasped. Rather, he emptied himself, taking the form of a slave, coming in human likeness; and, found human in appearance, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to death, even death on a cross. Because of this, God greatly exalted him and bestowed on him the name that is above every name, that at the name of Jesus every knee should bend, of those in heaven and on earth and under the earth, and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

readings.label: Responsorial Psalm
readings.text: I will praise you, Lord, in the assembly of your people. I will fulfill my vows before those who fear him. The lowly shall eat their fill; they who seek the LORD shall praise him: 'May your hearts be ever merry!' All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD; All the families of the nations shall bow down before him. For dominion is the LORD’s, and he rules the nations. To him alone shall bow down all who sleep in the earth. To him my soul shall live; my descendants shall serve him. Let the coming generation be told of the LORD that they may proclaim to a people yet to be born the justice he has shown.

readings.label: Gospel
readings.text: One of those at table with Jesus said to him, 'Blessed is the one who will dine in the Kingdom of God.' He replied to him, 'A man gave a great dinner to which he invited many. When the time for the dinner came, he dispatched his servant to say to those invited, “Come, everything is now ready.” But one by one, they all began to excuse themselves. The first said to him, “I have purchased a field and must go to examine it; I ask you, consider me excused.” And another said, “I have purchased five yoke of oxen and am on my way to evaluate them; I ask you, consider me excused.” And another said, “I have just married a woman, and therefore I cannot come.” The servant went and reported this to his master. Then the master of the house in a rage commanded his servant, “Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the town and bring in here the poor and the crippled, the blind and the lame.” The servant reported, “Sir, your orders have been carried out and still there is room.” The master then ordered the servant, “Go out to the highways and hedgerows and make people come in that my home may be filled. For, I tell you, none of those men who were invited will taste my dinner.”'

day: Tuesday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
